commit_message: Add ADR0155 managed local runtime core
pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation v4
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds ADR0155 from latest main, preserving current ADR0157 runtime-debug changes while adding the application-layer managed llama.cpp runtime, pinned provenance, GGUF registration, Windows/WSL execution identities, loopback lifecycle, and deterministic verification. Follow-up requests integrate the managed backend, current AI Studio visual fixtures, hardening, and measured-default gating.
